target_pattern: Use ir in preterite (fui/fuiste) to report completed movement in the past, with question frames and time anchors like ya and hace + tiempo.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using present-style movement sentences for past events, or translating ago/already loosely.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: For completed movement in the past, use ir in preterite (fui/fuiste) and anchor it with hace or ya.
natural_examples: Fui al banco hace una hora.
No fui a la oficina el lunes.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Fui a la tienda. -> turn into question (tú).
Base: ¿Fuiste al banco? -> answer yes in full sentence.
Base: Fui al cine. -> add yesterday.
Base: Ya fui al supermercado. -> make it negative.
Base: Fui a la playa. -> change time to two days ago.
Base: ¿Cuándo fuiste a la farmacia? -> answer an hour ago.
Base: Fui a la biblioteca. -> change destination to la oficina.
Base: No fui al gimnasio. -> make it affirmative.
Base: Fui al restaurante hace un día. -> change to three days ago.
Base: ¿Fuiste al hospital? -> change to plural subject (ustedes).
Base: Fui al aeropuerto. -> make it a question with cuándo.
Base: Ya fuiste a la tienda. -> rewrite as proper question form.
Base: Fui a la escuela el lunes. -> change day to martes.
Base: ¿Adónde fuiste? -> answer with I went to the park.
Base: Fui al parque. -> combine with contrast: but not to the beach.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the best pattern in Spanish.
prompts: I went to the store. (fui vs voy)
I go to the store (habit). (voy vs fui)
Did you go to the bank? (¿fuiste...? vs ¿vas...?) for yesterday.
I already went. (ya fui vs fui ya)
I went two days ago. (hace dos días vs en dos días)
When did you go? (¿cuándo fuiste? vs ¿cuándo vas?) for past.
Where did you go? (¿adónde fuiste? vs ¿dónde ibas?) finished action.
I did not go. (no fui vs no voy) past context.
Did you already go to the office? (¿ya fuiste...? vs ¿fuiste ya...?)
I went last week. (la semana pasada vs la semana próxima)

common_errors.mistake: Using voy for completed past trip
common_errors.why_it_happens: Present tense is used as default under pressure.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Infinitive patterns from prior lessons carry over.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Already vs not yet contrast not internalized.
